rationale: The 668-line module owns browser integration of one email-compose workflow: sender choice, recipient review, attachment readiness, explicit sending and actor/lifetime refusal. The only final delta scopes the actor-change diagnostic to the Email attachments region and accessible alert while preserving its message and zero upload/confirm/send assertions. It introduces no fixture branch, service owner, production rule or extra responsibility. This bounded locator correction is accepted at file scope; the byte-identical inherited setup and nested route callback remain separately identified and are not newly approved.

The 726-line existing suite groups Meeting Library browsing/deep links and the directly connected meeting assignment/transcript flow through its shared local Calendar fixture. The only successor delta adds operation-specific native creation metadata to the existing debrief POST response, preserving upload, extraction, reviewed-source, generation and save assertions. It adds eleven fixture lines and no new domain, framework, backend call or generic helper. Retaining the existing cohesive suite is reasonable for this bounded correction; unchanged long scenarios are still separately inherited/unreviewed. The preserved GET fixture is not qualified as a native debrief read projection.

This 169-line scenario follows one transcript-to-debrief interaction across explicit upload, same-key confirmation, failed/retried extraction, truncation disclosure, source review, generation and separate save. Its counters prove no duplicate uploaded bytes and no generation before review. The change replaces only the id-only save acknowledgement with meeting/client/actor-bound generated metadata. Keeping the sequence together makes the cross-step negative assertions readable; moving phases solely for the count would hide the causal workflow. This is an intercepted integration fixture, not native execution or full list-response evidence.

The 738-line inherited suite owns the meeting review surface: current saved-note source selection, reviewed generation, attachment approval and actor/meeting/client lifetime refusal. Its shared fixture supports those adjacent review flows. The successor change only replaces the existing debrief save response with current actor/context metadata and generated status; original meaningful assertions, denial controls and generation/save separation remain. There is no new production responsibility, broader mock service or cross-domain setup. Acceptance is for this exact bounded fixture correction, without a blanket path or JSX exemption.

The 126-line setup is the local synthetic request/state owner for the meeting-review scenarios, with bounded note/file holds, approval outcomes, generation outcomes and explicit counters. Its route branches are all consumed by this one review surface. Only the existing POST debrief result fields changed, including generated status, selected meeting/client, current actor and share timestamps; it does not add a new route or weaken unexpected-route checks. Extracting this one response or splitting the setup merely to silence the size signal would create unnecessary fixture plumbing.

The 104-line scenario verifies a single voice-source workflow from canonical voice fixture upload/transcription through explicit reviewed generation and separate save. It preserves the zero-generation-before-review and zero-save-before-explicit-save assertions plus exact method/body and storage/extraction counters. Its eleven added response fields provide the native generated receipt expected by the same existing save step. The scenario remains a coherent integration test using the canonical voice fixture, not an additional voice/provider implementation.

The 88-line describe callback groups action-specific artifact-receipt assertions: distinct note/debrief creation statuses, nullable original share attribution with contextual negatives, cleared note approval stamps and debrief edit metadata without nonexistent approval columns. It invokes the same canonical parser and requires no network or unrelated service mock. Loops compare the two real artifact kinds while keeping semantic differences explicit. Keeping this focused native-contract regression family together is appropriate; extracting each case merely to reduce callback measurement would not establish a different owner. The note-share positive fixture tests selected sharing fields only and is not a full native approved-note row oracle.
